US President Donald Trump is reportedly considering declaring the Iran war over, even as the Pentagon extends military deployments across the Middle East, according to a US media report. Trump is said to favour ending the war while relying on continued economic pressure to force Tehran to dismantle its nuclear programme or face collapse. At the same time, the US military is maintaining around 50,000 troops and 19 warships in the region, signalling preparations for a potentially prolonged conflict. The contrasting moves suggest Washington is weighing a possible political end to the war while keeping significant military options open.

recentItems.title: Israel Navy Signs Hamas Death Warrants, IDF Receives Drakon Submarine From Germany| Gaza War
recentItems.description:
Israel has announced that the naval submarine Drakon is currently en route from Germany to Israel, signifying the completion of the collaborative planning and construction phase between the two countries.

The Israeli military and Defense Ministry said the submarine was the sixth to be delivered to Israel.

The commencement ceremony for the submarine's voyage from the German shipbuilder TKMS's shipyard in Kiel was attended by the commander of the Israeli Navy, senior officials from the Israeli Ministry of Defense, Israel’s ambassador to Berlin, and the commander of the German Navy.

The submarine includes advanced and modern technologies that place Israel at the forefront of global military technology and strengthen the navy’s operational flexibility for many years to come.

The Israeli Navy has been quietly making waves in the war against Hamas and its allies.

Israel’s small but effective navy is often overlooked as the IDF takes on major operations in Gaza.

Nonetheless, it is playing a crucial role, and here's all you need to know...
